Family

Career

Military career

In May 1968, Bush joined the United States Air Force and was commissioned into the Texas Air National Guard .
In 1972, Bush was suspended from flying for failure to take a scheduled physical exam.
After service in the Texas Air National Guard , he graduated from Harvard Business School in 1975, before going back to Texas and founding his own oil company .

Business career

In 1977, Bush established Arbusto Energy , a small oil exploration company, which began operations in 1978.
